g.text: SS-11 Save and submit a quiz or assessment
Pass when exact percentage meets threshold.
Preserve highest score and any previous pass.
Optional quizzes do not affect course progress.
Course progress displays 100% only when every required
quiz in the Student's started revision is passed.
All required quizzes passed: complete course
and award its badge at most once.
Latest completed result informs new suggestions.
Untimed, unlimited retakes create new attempts.
At most one unfinished attempt per quiz/assessment.
